categories.main_business_segments: Xiamen Sinictek Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the machine vision inspection equipment sector, focusing on the research, development, production, sales, and related technical services of high-end 3D machine vision inspection devices. Its main products include 3D solder paste inspection (SPI) and 3D automated optical inspection (AOI) equipment, serving electronic assembly processes such as PCB SMT lines and semiconductor packaging. The company also develops advanced inspection solutions for industries like consumer electronics, automotive electronics, lithium batteries, semiconductors, and communication equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including programmable electronic gratings for 3D surface contour measurement, proprietary underlying and application-level machine vision algorithms, and AI deep learning modules based on convolutional neural networks. Its production model combines standardized manufacturing with semi-customized development to meet diverse customer needs. The manufacturing process emphasizes safety, lean production, and green practices, with strict quality control from raw materials to finished products. The company also integrates multi-disciplinary technologies such as optics, electronics, mechanical automation, and artificial intelligence.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the electronic manufacturing industry, including sectors such as consumer electronics, automotive electronics, lithium battery production, semiconductor manufacturing, and communication equipment. The company’s products are widely used in SMT production lines, semiconductor back-end packaging, and large-size PCB inspection, supporting clients in achieving intelligent transformation and high-quality production. Major customers include leading enterprises in these fields, with the top five customers accounting for 17.5% of annual sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily concentrated in China, with domestic sales accounting for over 97% of revenue. It has established branches and offices in major Chinese cities such as Shanghai, Shenzhen, Tianjin, and Chongqing. Internationally, it has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore to support overseas market expansion, actively participating in global exhibitions and leveraging the Belt and Road initiative to enhance its global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiamen Sinictek operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of machine vision inspection equipment. It sources key components such as lenses, cameras, and computer hosts from qualified suppliers but has achieved significant localization and independent development of core components. The company provides integrated inspection solutions to downstream electronic assembly manufacturers, enabling quality control and process optimization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment focused on advancing 3D machine vision technologies, AI deep learning algorithms, and high-precision mechanical platforms. It emphasizes innovation in light source systems, software algorithms, and AI modules to enhance detection accuracy and efficiency. Strategic initiatives include developing new product lines such as online X-Ray inspection and semiconductor packaging inspection equipment, expanding AI applications, and fostering industry-academia collaborations. The company also aims to accelerate import substitution and expand its presence in emerging markets like Micro-LED and 5G.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of machine vision inspection equipment, including 3D SPI and 3D AOI devices, along with related technical services. The company employs a mixed sales model combining direct sales and distributor partnerships. It also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies. The majority of revenue comes from product sales, with a small portion from after-sales services and software solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xiamen Sinictek is positioned as a leading domestic innovator and standard-setter in the high-end machine vision inspection equipment industry in China. It has successfully replaced imported products in key segments, leveraging its technological advantages and localized services. The company is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise, competing effectively against international suppliers by offering high-performance, cost-effective solutions and superior after-sales support.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 348.7 million, a 5.21% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 77.3 million, down 22.21%. Total assets reached about RMB 1.13 billion, showing a 3.2% increase year-over-year. The company increased R&D investment by 39.09% to RMB 35.9 million, representing 10.3% of revenue. Despite some revenue decline, the company maintains a solid financial base with ongoing investments in innovation and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary core technologies such as programmable electronic gratings, self-developed algorithms, and AI-powered inspection modules, enabling high precision, stability, and efficiency in 3D machine vision inspection. Its products cover a broad range of applications, including complex semiconductor packaging and large-size PCB inspection, meeting stringent quality demands. The company emphasizes localized innovation, cost-effectiveness, and comprehensive after-sales service, supporting customers’ intelligent manufacturing transformation and enabling import substitution in China’s high-end inspection equipment market.
